annotation.title_clean: Standards Document: Operation of Aircraft – Part IV – International Operations (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems)
annotation.title_en: Standards Document: Operation of Aircraft – Part IV – International Operations (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems)
annotation.venue: Civil Aviation Authority of Fiji Standards Documents
annotation.summary_en: Fiji CAAF Standards Document transposing ICAO Annex 6 Part IV, setting requirements for international operations of certificated remotely piloted aircraft systems: RPAS operator certificates, C2 link oversight, remote crew licensing and training, equipment, recorders, maintenance, security and dangerous goods.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators need a valid RPAS operator certificate (ROC) issued by the State of the Operator for international RPAS operations
Operators must implement a safety management system and establish SLAs for C2 Link services approved by the State
Remote pilots must be licensed; training, fatigue management and qualification requirements apply to remote flight crew
RPAS must carry recorder systems, detect-and-avoid capability and an emergency power supply at the remote pilot station
Applies only to Certified-category RPAS under Annex 8; Open and Specific categories excluded
